题目.题目1:
【听力】听录音，回答问题：说话人说什么时候开始疏散？
听：The evacuation of the town started at midnight.
A. 中午
B. 早上
C. 傍晚
D. 半夜
题目.题目2:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：We had a fire ______ drill at school yesterday.
A. evacuate
B. evacuated
C. evacuation
D. evacuating
题目.题目3:
【选词填空】从 evacuate、evacuation 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
题干：The police had to ______ the building quickly.
考点：词性转换
题目.题目4:
【适当形式填空】用所给单词的适当形式填空。
题干：There were three ______ in the city last year because of floods. (evacuation)
考点：变形
题目.题目5:
【改错】句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
题干：The evacuate of the village took two hours.
考点：词性转换
题目.题目6:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：During an evacuation, everyone should ______.
A. stay calm and follow the teacher
B. run back for their bags
C. take the lift
D. shout loudly
考点：用法
题目.题目7:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：An evacuation means ______.
A. building a new house
B. having a big party
C. taking a long holiday
D. moving people away from danger
考点：用法
题目.答案:
【1】D（半夜）
讲解：evacuation 疏散，at midnight 在半夜。
【2】C（evacuation）
讲解：名词作定语，fire evacuation drill 火灾疏散演习。
【3】evacuate
讲解：had to 后面接动词原形 evacuate。
【4】evacuations
讲解：three 后面接复数 evacuations。
【5】evacuate → evacuation
讲解：the … of 中间要名词 evacuation。
【6】A（stay calm and follow the teacher）
讲解：疏散时要保持冷静、跟着老师走。
【7】D（moving people away from danger）
讲解：evacuation 是把人从危险的地方撤走。
